moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Great Expectation' as the new chart week begins.

angles.name: Chart Topper News
angles.copy: New chart week, same number one! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' is still dominating the Official UK Singles Chart. Can anyone knock her off?

angles.name: Weekend Listen
angles.copy: Your weekend playlist just got its official leader. Sienna Spiro at #1 with 'Great Expectation' for another week. Get it on repeat!

moments.title: Sting's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: Gordon Sumner, better known as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, turns 75 on October 2nd.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to a stellar solo career, his music is truly timeless. What's your favourite Sting track?

angles.name: Police Era
angles.copy: Turning 75 tomorrow, Sting helped define a generation with The Police. 'Every Breath You Take' or 'Roxanne'? Which classic are you playing?

moments.title: Mike Rutherford's 76th Birthday
moments.blurb: Mike Rutherford, co-founder of Genesis and Mike + The Mechanics, celebrates his 76th birthday on October 2nd.

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to Mike Rutherford! A founding member of Genesis and the driving force behind Mike + The Mechanics. What's your favourite of his tracks?

angles.name: Double Trouble
angles.copy: From 'I Can't Dance' with Genesis to 'The Living Years' with The Mechanics, Mike Rutherford (76 tomorrow!) has given us so many hits. Which band do you prefer?

moments.title: Gwen Stefani's 57th Birthday
moments.blurb: Gwen Stefani, lead singer of No Doubt and a successful solo artist, turns 57 on October 3rd.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Princess
angles.copy: Can you believe Gwen Stefani turns 57 on Sunday? From No Doubt's 'Don't Speak' to solo smash 'Hollaback Girl', she's still got it!

angles.name: Iconic Style
angles.copy: Happy early birthday to Gwen Stefani, turning 57! Beyond the hits, her style is legendary. What's your favourite Gwen look?

moments.title: Tommy Lee's 64th Birthday
moments.blurb: Mötley Crüe drummer and rock wildman Tommy Lee celebrates his 64th birthday on October 3rd.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Still drumming up a storm at 64! Happy Birthday to Mötley Crüe's very own Tommy Lee this Sunday. What's your favourite Crüe anthem?

angles.name: Drummer Goals
angles.copy: From the biggest stages to the wildest stories, Tommy Lee (64 on Oct 3rd) is a true rock icon. Name a more iconic drummer... we'll wait.

moments.title: Chris Lowe's 67th Birthday
moments.blurb: Chris Lowe, the often-enigmatic keyboardist of synth-pop legends Pet Shop Boys, turns 67 on October 4th.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to Chris Lowe of the Pet Shop Boys this Monday! The man behind the synths and the iconic sunglasses. What's your favourite PSB track?

angles.name: West End Boy
angles.copy: From 'West End Girls' to 'Go West', Chris Lowe (67 on Oct 4th) has been a constant in Pet Shop Boys' incredible career. Celebrate with a classic!

moments.title: Thom Yorke's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: Radiohead frontman and acclaimed solo artist Thom Yorke celebrates his 58th birthday on October 7th.

angles.name: Radiohead Legend
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the one and only Thom Yorke this Thursday! What's the Radiohead song that means the most to you?

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: From 'Creep' to 'Karma Police', Thom Yorke (58 on Oct 7th) has one of the most distinctive voices in rock. Which era of his music do you love most?

moments.title: Toni Braxton's 59th Birthday
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning R&B superstar Toni Braxton, known for hits like 'Un-Break My Heart', turns 59 on October 7th.

angles.name: R&B Queen
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Toni Braxton, who turns 59 this Thursday! 'Un-Break My Heart' is still an absolute masterpiece. What's your favourite Toni track?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: With a voice that still gives us chills, Toni Braxton celebrates her 59th birthday on October 7th. Her influence on R&B is undeniable!

moments.title: Bruno Mars' 41st Birthday
moments.blurb: Multi-Grammy winner and global pop sensation Bruno Mars celebrates his 41st birthday on October 8th.

angles.name: Birthday Funk
angles.copy: It's Bruno Mars' 41st birthday next Friday! Get ready to feel the funk and celebrate the '24K Magic' man. What's your top Bruno song?

angles.name: Pop Superstar
angles.copy: 41 years young next week! Bruno Mars continues to be one of the biggest names in music. Which of his hits gets you dancing every time?

moments.title: Sharon Osbourne's 74th Birthday
moments.blurb: Music manager, TV personality, and rock matriarch Sharon Osbourne turns 74 on October 9th.

angles.name: Rock Matriarch
angles.copy: Happy 74th Birthday to the one and only Sharon Osbourne next Saturday! From managing Ozzy to 'The X Factor', she's a true force. What's your favourite Sharon moment?

angles.name: TV Personality
angles.copy: Turning 74 on October 9th! Sharon Osbourne has kept us entertained for decades. What's your favourite show she's been a part of?

moments.title: Autumn Colour Peak
moments.blurb: The UK's trees are starting to show their beautiful autumn colours, with many areas expected to reach their peak in the coming weeks.

angles.name: Golden Hues
angles.copy: Autumn is officially here! Those beautiful golden and red leaves are starting to show across the UK. Where's your favourite spot for a crisp autumn walk?

angles.name: Weekend Walks
angles.copy: Get out and enjoy the stunning autumn colours this weekend! Perfect for a walk, a hot drink, and some fresh air. Don't forget your camera!
